blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Geospatial foundation models are a widely adopted starting point for remote sensing tasks. Most are pretrained on Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. Many applications instead rely on very high resolution (VHR) imagery, where individual buildings, roads, and amenities are resolved. We study which pretraining regimes transfer well to this scale. We introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark suite of ten datasets at 1.5m GSD or finer spanning five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. We evaluate twelve encoders in three pretraining tiers with frozen backbones at two training-data fractions. We find that both pretraining on large natural-image collections and VHR-specific pretraining transfer effectively to VHR tasks, with complementary strengths. SkySense leads when labels are scarce; at the full label fraction the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L edges ahead, with the two close together there. Encoders pretrained only on Sentinel-scale imagery transfer least well under RGB input. Guided by these complementary results, we continue the self-supervised pretraining of DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million held-out VHR tiles and evaluate the resulting encoder without changing the downstream protocol. The continued model gives a clear improvement over the released backbone when labels are scarce and a modest one at the full fraction, at no increase in inference parameters or compute. These findings support a generalize-then-specialize strategy: already strong, broad natural-image pretraining can be further improved by a short VHR continuation stage while preserving its general visual features.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Self-supervised pretraining on large satellite archives has made
Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs), also referred to as Earth Observation Foundation Models (EO-FMs), a common backbone for remote
sensing tasks. Most rely on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery, which is openly
available on a global scale with high temporal revisit, at a Ground
Sampling Distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. This large amount of
medium to high-resolution data has driven substantial progress in broad-area
scene analysis, but leaves an important resolution regime largely
unaddressed: Very High Resolution (VHR).

blocks.en:
We focus on the practical demand that lies in this regime. Applications from
disaster response to infrastructure mapping depend on VHR imagery,
acquired from satellite platforms such as
WorldView, Pléiades, and SPOT, or from aerial and drone surveys. At such resolutions, fine-grained features such as
buildings, roads, amenities, and tree crowns are discriminated at the
pixel level, enabling spatially precise tasks including building
footprint extraction, road mapping, post-disaster damage assessment,
canopy height regression, photovoltaic panel detection, tree species
classification, and many more. Many disaster tasks are time-critical and
demand object-level accurate spatial outputs.

blocks.en:
Whether existing GeoFMs transfer well to this resolution regime has not
been systematically evaluated. Our first hypothesis is that
pretraining on medium to high-resolution Sentinel archives may be insufficient
at VHR, given the substantial scale mismatch between pretraining and
inference conditions. Conversely, we hypothesize that computer-vision
models pretrained on large RGB natural image corpora may transfer well
to optical VHR imagery: beyond sharing the same three-channel representation,
VHR imagery is closer to natural images than Sentinel-2 imagery in
terms of spatial scale, texture, visual diversity, and fine-grained detail.
We therefore investigate whether GeoFMs without VHR pretraining underperform
on VHR tasks and whether generic RGB models provide a strong alternative to
VHR-specific pretraining.

We make three contributions. First, we introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark of
ten VHR datasets spanning five task families and covering eight
application domains on both satellite and aerial optical sensors, under
one common evaluation framework. Second, we evaluate twelve encoders
organized into three pretraining tiers under a fixed protocol at two
training-data fractions (10 and 100%). Third, as a design direction
derived from the benchmark’s results, and to test whether label-free adaptation
can improve an already strong natural image encoder on the VHR domain,
we assemble 1.02 million VHR tiles from seven open sources and use them to
continue DINOv3 ViT-L’s self-supervised pretraining.

Together, VHR-Bench and this
evaluation give the community a shared reference for how well current

the assumption that geospatial pretraining is inherently preferable for
VHR imagery, and provide a basis for assessing the additional value of

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
II-A Geospatial foundation
models
blocks.zh:
地理空间基金会
模型

blocks.en:
A foundation model is trained on broad data, generally with
self-supervision at scale, and can be adapted to a wide range of
downstream tasks [ 10 , 11 ] .
Geospatial foundation models apply this to Earth observation: they learn
general-purpose representations from large unlabeled Earth observation
archives typically through self-supervised objectives, then transfer
to downstream tasks with limited supervision.
A large part of the published models target the Sentinel and Landsat
archives where global coverage and frequent
revisit provide plenty of pretraining data, for example Prithvi-EO
2.0 [ 12 ] and TerraMind [ 13 ] . Others also include
higher-resolution or multi-sensor imagery, varying the GSD of their
pretraining data, such as DOFA [ 14 ] , Panopticon [ 15 ] ,
SkySense [ 16 ] and EoS-FM [ 17 ] . In parallel, general-purpose
computer vision models such as DINOv3 [ 18 ] learn transferable
features from large web-image collections without any remote-sensing-specific focus.
This study benchmarks these pretraining-type families in the VHR regime.

blocks.en: A related line of work, represented by Tessera [ 19 ] and AlphaEarth Foundations [ 20 ] , distributes precomputed annual geospatial embeddings at 10m resolution rather than a model intended for direct application to imagery. Although valuable for large-scale spatial and temporal analysis, these products cannot resolve several object-level or temporally narrow VHR tasks considered here, such as counting individual cattle or detecting localized post-disaster changes, and are therefore outside the scope of this benchmark. This study instead benchmarks transferable pretraining-model families in the VHR regime.

blocks.en:
Evaluation of GeoFMs has moved from heterogeneous selected-dataset
studies to standardized multi-task benchmarks. The PANGAEA
benchmark [ 21 ] defines a standardized
evaluation protocol spanning a diverse set of datasets, tasks,
resolutions, sensor modalities, and temporal settings, and reports that
geospatial foundation models at the time did not consistently outperform
supervised baselines such as U-Net and a vanilla ViT.
GEO-Bench-2 [ 22 ] assembles nineteen
permissively licensed datasets across five task families,
classification, segmentation, regression, object detection, and instance
segmentation, and introduces capability groups that rank models on
datasets sharing characteristics such as resolution, spectral bands, and
temporality; among its findings, models pretrained on natural images
excel on high-resolution tasks, while Earth observation specific models
are stronger on multispectral applications.

blocks.en: II-C Continual and domain-adaptive pretraining
blocks.zh: II-C 连续和领域适应性预训

blocks.en: Once a strong general-purpose encoder is available, domain specialization does not need to restart pretraining from random initialization. Continual pretraining instead resumes self-supervised training on data from the target domain. This strategy can add domain knowledge at a fraction of the cost of training a foundation model from scratch, but it also risks catastrophic forgetting or degradation of dense features. FINO [ 24 ] , for example, adapts a visual foundation model while regularizing feature geometry, and related analyses show that unconstrained continued pretraining can affect global and dense representations differently [ 25 ] . Our study uses the original DINOv3 self-supervised objective for a short VHR continuation stage, evaluates the result with the same frozen protocol as the released encoders, and measures where its representation changes using centered kernel alignment [ 26 ] .

III Very High Resolution: Definition and
Scope
blocks.zh:
三、结 论 甚高分辨率:定义和
范围

blocks.en:
We define VHR as RGB optical imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD)
of 1.5m or finer, and adopt 1.5m as the upper bound for the suite. This
threshold is set by the SPOT 6 and 7 sensors used in the Open-Canopy-Small
dataset, the coarsest platform admitted; all other datasets are finer.
At this resolution, in the terminology of Strahler et
al. [ 27 ] , the datasets fall in an
H-resolution situation, in which scene elements are larger than the
resolution cell and are individually identifiable, as opposed to the
L-resolution situation of medium-resolution imagery, where elements are
smaller than the cell and are not individually detectable.

blocks.en:
We release a config-driven evaluation framework
built as an extended fork of the PANGAEA codebase, intended for seamless reproducibility and upstream contribution. The evaluation code, configurations, and dataset manifests will be released 6 6 6 upon acceptance. so the full suite can be re-run. blocks.en: The two DINOv3 ViT-L encoders provide a matched comparison in which the architecture, parameter count, input size, and evaluation protocol are held fixed while the pretraining data change. The web-pretrained LVD variant obtains a slightly higher aggregate score at both label fractions: 64.0 versus 63.4 at 10%, and 69.5 versus 69.1 at 100%. blocks.en: IX Discussion
blocks.zh: 九. 讨论

blocks.en: IX-A Interpretation of the findings
blocks.zh: 九. A 对调查结果的解释

blocks.en: The released-encoder benchmark does not reveal a general performance separation between natural-image and high-resolution remote-sensing pretraining. The first six positions are divided equally between CV-FM and HR-FM encoders, and each tier contains both leading and mid-ranked models. Strong web-image pretraining is therefore a competitive alternative to high-resolution remote-sensing pretraining for VHR RGB tasks. This conclusion concerns aggregate transfer performance, rather than equivalence between the two pretraining strategies: their per-dataset results show complementary strengths.
blocks.zh: 发布编码器基准没有显示自然图像和高分辨率遥感预培训之间的一般性能分离. 前6个职位在CV-FM和HR-FM编码器之间平分,每个级别都包含领先和中位的模型. 因此,强大的网络图像预培训是VHR RGB任务高分辨率遥感预培训的竞争性替代. 这一结论涉及总的转移性能,而不是两个预训战略之间的等同性:它们各自数据集的结果表明互补优势。

blocks.en: SkySense provides the strongest result when labels are scarce, scoring 65.8 at the 10% fraction compared with 64.0 for the best CV-FM, and it ranks first on the mean of the two fractions. At the full fraction, however, DINOv3 ViT-L (LVD) scores 69.5 and SkySense 69.2. The low-label result is consistent with the possibility that high-resolution remote-sensing pretraining improves sample efficiency, but the comparison cannot isolate the effect of pretraining data. SkySense uses a 655M-parameter hierarchical Swin-H backbone with 301.6 GFLOPs, whereas DINOv3 ViT-L has 303M parameters and 164.7 GFLOPs. SkySense also provides a native multi-scale feature hierarchy, while features from the single-scale ViT, like DINOv3, are resampled for the decoder. Architecture, capacity, compute, and pretraining data are therefore all potential contributors to its low-label advantage.
blocks.zh: SkySense在标签稀缺时提供最强的结果,与最佳CV-FM的64.0相比,在10%的分数中得分65.8,在两个分数的平均值上排名第一. 然而,在满分中,DINov3 VIT-L(LVD)得分69.5和SkySense69.2. 低标签结果与高分辨率遥感预训提高样本效率的可能性是一致的,但比较不能孤立预训数据的效果. SkySense使用655M参数级 Swin-H主干线有301.6 GFLOPs,而DINov3 VIT-L则有303M参数和164.7 GFLOPs. SkySense还提供了本土的多尺度特征等级,而来自单尺度的ViT的特征,如DINOv3,则为解码器重印. 因此,结构、能力、计算和预先培训数据都是其低标签优势的潜在贡献者。

blocks.en: The matched DINOv3 comparison gives more direct evidence about pretraining source. With architecture, training recipe and evaluation fixed, the web-pretrained LVD variant is slightly ahead in aggregate at both fractions. More specialized pretraining is thus not sufficient on its own to improve average VHR transfer. Nevertheless, the per-task results contain interesting information: at the full fraction, the SAT variant is stronger on canopy-height regression and both object-detection datasets, whereas LVD is stronger on segmentation, change-detection, and classification. This pattern suggests that satellite pretraining may preserve useful spatial or physically grounded cues while large-scale web pretraining supports broader semantic discrimination.
blocks.zh: 匹配的DINOv3比较为预训源提供了更直接的证据. 随着结构、培训配方和评价的固定,网络预选的低消费量变量在两个部分的总数上都略为领先。 因此,更专门的预先培训本身不足以改善平均自愿人力转移。 尽管如此,每个任务的结果都包含着有趣的信息:在完全分量上,SAT变体在树冠-高度回归和两个对象-检测数据集上更强,而LVD则在分化,变化-检测和分类上更强. 这种模式表明,卫星预训可能保留有用的空间或实际存在的提示,而大规模网络预训则支持更广泛的语义歧视。

blocks.en: Several properties of the pretraining corpora could explain the aggregate advantage of LVD, but the present experiments do not distinguish among them. LVD-1689M contains approximately 3.4 times as many images as SAT-493M and is likely to cover substantially greater visual and semantic diversity. SAT-493M, on the other hand, consists of imagery from one provider at a single nominal resolution. The observed difference could therefore reflect corpus size, visual diversity, sensor diversity, or their interaction, rather than a disadvantage of satellite imagery itself. Isolating the different factors would require controlled pretraining experiments with matched data volumes and training budgets.
blocks.zh: 预训蝎子的几个特性可以解释LVD的总优点,但目前的实验并没有区分它们. 拉特-1689年 M包含的图像大约是SAT-493M的3.4倍,并可能涵盖大幅提高的视觉和语义多样性. 另一方面,SAT-493M则由一个供应商以单一的名义分辨率提供的图像组成。 因此,观测到的差异可以反映实体大小、视觉多样性、传感器多样性或其相互作用,而不是卫星图像本身的缺点。 将不同因素隔离开来将需要有控制的预培训试验,并配有相应的数据量和培训预算。

blocks.en: The MidRes-FM encoders occupy the final three positions, providing the clearest tier-level pattern in the benchmark. This supports the hypothesized difficulty of transferring representations learned on multi-spectral inputs and at Sentinel or Landsat scale to RGB imagery in which small individual objects and fine spatial boundaries are resolved. These encoders are designed for multispectral inputs but receive only RGB with their remaining channels set to zero, and their backbones are frozen. The experiments therefore show that the evaluated Sentinel-scale encoders transfer least effectively when repurposed as frozen RGB encoders for VHR imagery, not that medium-resolution pretraining is intrinsically ineffective in its native modality. General benchmarks like PANGAEA [ 21 ] , GEO-Bench [ 23 ] and GEO-Benchand 2 [ 22 ] are instead the right tool to evaluate MOdRes-FM encoders in their native modalities.
blocks.zh: 中继器 调频编码器占据最后三个位置,提供了基准中最清晰的层次图案. 这支持了将从多光谱输入和在哨兵或Landsat尺度上学到的表示法转移给RGB图像的假设困难,在这种图像中,个别小物体和细小的空间界限得到解决。 这些编码器是为多光谱输入而设计的,但仅接收RGB,其剩余通道设置为0,其骨干被冻结. 因此,实验表明,经过评估的Sentinel比例编码器在重新用作VHR图像的冷冻RGB编码器时,其传输效率最低,而不是中分辨率预训在其原生模式中本质上无效。 PANGAEA [21],GEO-Bench [23] 和GEO-Benchand 2 [22] 等一般基准相反是评估MOdRes-FM编码器的本土模式的正确工具.

blocks.en: IX-B Generalize, then specialize
blocks.zh: IX-B 一般化,然后专门化

blocks.en: The continued-pretraining experiment turns the released-model comparison into a design test. Starting from the strongest web encoder and continuing the same self-supervised objective on VHR imagery improves its aggregate at both fractions, with the clearest gain when labels are scarce. The continued model obtains the highest observed full-fraction score and remains second to SkySense at 10% labels, without changing its inference cost. Broad visual pretraining is therefore not merely a competing alternative to VHR pretraining; it is also a useful initialization for it.
blocks.zh: 继续预训实验将发行的模型比较转化为设计测试. 从最强的网络编码器开始,在VHR图像上继续同样的自我监督的目标,提高了其两个分数的总和,在标签稀缺时,其收益最为明显. 续作型号获得观测到的最高全折射分数,并以10%的标签保持次于SkySense,而不改变其推论成本. 因此,广泛的视觉预训不仅仅是VHR预训的一种相互竞争的替代方法;对于它来说,它也是一个有益的初始化。

blocks.en:
The ordering of the three DINOv3 checkpoints suggests that the sequence of data
regimes matters. Training on the specialized SAT-493M corpus alone does not exceed
the web model in aggregate, whereas beginning from LVD-1689M and then specializing
on a smaller, multi-source VHR corpus does. The most plausible interpretation is
that the first stage learns broadly transferable semantic and visual structure and
the second adjusts it to VHR texture, scale, and acquisition statistics. DINOv3’s
original web pretraining was already extended at scale until downstream performance
saturated [ 18 ] ; the observed movement after switching to VHR data is
therefore more naturally attributed to the new domain than to another short block
of unchanged web training. The CKA and ImageNet-retention results support this
reading: early features and general recognition performance remain stable while
the deepest layers move.

blocks.en: IX-D Limitations
blocks.zh: 九-D 限制

blocks.en: The pretraining tiers are descriptive groupings rather than controlled experimental conditions. Models within and across tiers differ in architecture, training objective, capacity, pretraining volume, modalities and sensor coverage. Except for the two DINOv3 ViT-L variants, performance differences cannot be attributed solely to pretraining resolution or domain. Controlled comparisons that vary one property at a time would be required to separate the effects of resolution, data scale, architecture, and modality.
blocks.zh: 预训等级是描述性的分组,而不是受控制的实验条件. 各级内部和之间的模式在结构、培训目标、能力、培训前数量、模式和传感器覆盖范围方面各不相同。 除了两个DINov3 VIT-L变体外,性能差异不能仅仅归结于训练前分辨率或域. 需要每次对一个财产进行有控制的比较,以区分分辨率、数据尺度、结构和模式的影响。

blocks.en: The study is restricted to RGB optical imagery. Near-infrared, multispectral, and VHR SAR inputs are outside its scope. This restriction particularly affects the MidRes-FM encoders, which receive zero-filled non-RGB channels, and may also limit the forestry tasks, for which near-infrared information is informative. The conclusions therefore characterize transfer to RGB VHR imagery rather than the full capabilities of the evaluated encoders.
blocks.zh: 该研究仅限于RGB光学图像. 近红外线、多光谱和甚高分辨率合成孔径雷达投入不在它的范围之内。 这一限制特别影响到中继Res-FM编码器,它们接收零填充的非RGB通道,还可能限制林业任务,对此,近红外线信息很丰富. 因此,这些结论将转让给RGB VHR图像,而不是被评价编码器的全部能力。

blocks.en: The benchmark spans five task families but is not numerically balanced among them: four datasets address semantic segmentation and a fifth addresses a very similar task, pixel-level change detection. Classification, detection and regression consequently have narrower task and geographic coverage. The detection datasets both concern small animals over relatively uniform backgrounds and should not be treated as representative of vehicle, ship, or building detection. Likewise, classification is limited to France and Germany, regression to France, and detection to the United States and New Zealand. These limitations primarily reflect the scarcity of openly licensed VHR datasets.
blocks.zh: 该基准跨越5个任务家族,但是在数量上并不平衡:4个数据集处理语义分裂,第5个数据集处理非常相似的任务,像素级变化检测. 因此,分类、检测和回归的任务和地理范围较窄。 探测数据集既涉及背景相对统一的小型动物,也不应被视为车辆、船舶或建筑物探测的代表性。 同样,分类仅限于法国和德国,回归法国,检测美国和新西兰. 这些限制主要反映了公开许可的VHR数据集的稀缺性.

blocks.en: The evaluation uses a frozen backbone, one predetermined decoder per task family, and a fixed training budget of 80 epochs. This supports a uniform comparison of representation quality but does not measure the models’ performance after end-to-end finetuning, their convergence speed, or their maximum possible performance with an architecture-tailored decoder design. Native hierarchical features may also interact differently with the selected decoders than resampled single-scale transformer features.
blocks.zh: 评价使用一个冻结的骨干,一个预先确定的每个任务家族的解码器,以及80个世纪的固定培训预算. 这支持对表示质量进行统一比较,但并不衡量模型在端到端微调后的表现、其趋同速度,或与结构特异的解码器设计的最大可能性能。 原生的分级特性也可能与所选的解码器进行不同的交互,而不是重印的单级变压器特性.

blocks.en: Finally, the aggregate assigns equal value to every dataset, irrespective of dataset size. This prevents large datasets from dominating the benchmark but allows highly discriminative datasets to affect the ordering of closely matched encoders. The leave-one-out analysis shows that the ranking is generally stable, with only the full-fraction leader changing when PureForest is removed. Conversely, the near-saturation of m-pv4ger gives that dataset little ability to distinguish the strongest encoders. Future benchmark versions should retain per-dataset results alongside the aggregate and consider replacing or extending tasks that no longer separate state-of-the-art models.
blocks.zh: 最后,总和为每个数据集分配等值,而不论数据集大小. 这使得大型数据集无法主导基准,但允许高度歧视性的数据集影响对紧密匹配编码器的订购. "一离不开"分析显示排名一般稳定,只有完全违纪的领导者在纯森林被移除时会有所改变. 相反,m-pv4ger的近饱和度使得数据集几乎没有能力区分最强编码器. 未来基准版本应保留每个数据集的结果与汇总结果,并考虑取代或延长不再单独采用最新模式的任务。

blocks.en: X Conclusion
blocks.zh: 十. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced VHR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating visual encoders on RGB very-high-resolution Earth observation imagery. The suite spans ten datasets, five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. Using a common frozen-backbone protocol, we evaluated twelve encoders at two label fractions to examine how pretraining domain and resolution relate to transfer at VHR.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了VHR-Bench,这是在RGB甚高分辨率地球观测图像上评价视觉编码器的基准. 该套套间涵盖10个数据集、5个任务家庭、8个应用领域以及卫星和航空平台。 我们使用一个普通的冷冻背骨协议,对两个标签分数的十二个编码器进行了评价,以审查在VHR中预训域和解析度与转移的关系.

blocks.en: Our results show that high-resolution remote-sensing and general-purpose computer-vision encoders both provide strong representations for VHR tasks but exhibit complementary task profiles, whereas encoders pretrained only at a Sentinel or Landsat scale transfer least effectively under RGB input. The matched DINOv3 comparison makes the complementarity especially visible: web pretraining is stronger in aggregate and on semantic tasks, while satellite pretraining retains advantages on canopy-height regression and object detection.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,高分辨率的遥感和通用计算机视码器既为甚高分辨率任务提供了强有力的表述,又显示出互补的任务简介,而编码器只在 " 哨兵 " 或 " Landsat " 尺度上进行预先培训,在RGB投入下转让效果最低。 匹配的DINOv3比较使得互补性特别明显:网络预训在汇总和语义任务上更为强大,而卫星预训则保留了冠高回归和物体检测方面的优势.

blocks.en: Guided by this diagnostic, we continued the self-supervised training of the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million VHR tiles and returned the resulting encoder to the benchmark. The continued model improved on its initialization and obtains the highest observed full-fraction aggregate, and ranks second only to SkySense at 10% labels. Because only the weights change, the gain adds no inference cost. Representation analysis further shows that the early layers and ImageNet recognition are preserved while the deepest layers specialize.
blocks.zh: 在这种诊断的指导下,我们继续以102万瓦的VHR瓷砖对网络预选的DINOv3 VIT-L进行自我监督培训,并将由此产生的编码器退回基准. 持续型号在初始化上有所改进,获得了观测到的最高全折射总量,以10%的标签位列仅次于SkySense. 因为只有权重变化,收益不增加推论成本. 表现分析进一步显示,早期的地层和ImageNet识别被保留下来,而最深层专门化.

blocks.en: Overall, VHR-specific pretraining is not required to obtain strong performance on the tasks considered here, but neither is general web-image pretraining uniformly preferable. The strongest practical direction may therefore be to combine the scale and visual diversity of natural-image pretraining with the spatial, sensor, and physical priors available in high-resolution Earth observation imagery. As a first step in this direction, a short label-free run of continual VHR pretraining specializes a web-pretrained encoder, with the largest benefit when labels are scarce. VHR-Bench provides a reproducible basis for evaluating such models and for measuring whether future pretraining strategies improve performance consistently across VHR applications rather than on a narrow set of tasks.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,针对虚拟人力资源的预训不需要在本文所考虑的任务上获得强效表现,但一般的网络图像预训也不统一可取. 因此,最有力的实际方向可能是将自然图像预演的规模和视觉多样性与高分辨率地球观测图像中可用的空间、传感器和物理前身结合起来。 作为朝这个方向迈出的第一步,持续VHR预训的短路无标签运行专门设置了网络预训编码器,在标签稀缺时受益最大. VHR-Bench为评价这些模型和衡量未来培训前战略是否在VHR应用中持续改善业绩,而不是在一套狭窄的任务上提供可复制的基础。
